title: UDP Send
text: Send data over UDP network to specified remote machine, 1 input; {Remote address} sets the remote host name or address remote host name or IP, {Remote port} sets the remote host port, {Local address} sets the local host name or IP, {Local port} sets the port of local host for binding, {Enable local port sharing} allows other UDP sockets to bind to same local, {Verify address and port connectivity} sets the remote machine connection verification, {UDP packet size} sets the maximum number of bytes written in datagram, {Byte order} sets the sequential order and {Enable blocking mode} sets the simulation waits while sending data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Data values to send vector | matrix | array

params.name: Remote address
params.values: Remote host name or address remote host name or IP address

params.name: Remote port
params.values: Remote host port 9090 (default) | remote host port

params.name: Local address
params.values: Local host name or IP address 0.0.0.0 (default) | local host name or IP address

params.name: Local port
params.values: Port of local host for binding -1 (default) | local host port

params.name: Enable local port sharing
params.values: Allow other UDP sockets to bind to same local port off (default) | on

params.name: UDP packet size
params.values: Maximum number of bytes written in datagram packet 512 (default) | numeric

params.name: Byte order
params.values: Sequential order of bytes big-endian (default) | little-endian

params.name: Enable blocking mode
params.values: Simulation waits while sending data on (default) | off
